blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of food and beer selections, live music from local and touring artists, and special events. The venue hosts a famous food challenge called the Kodiak Arrest involving eating a large seafood meal within 60 minutes. Additional venues include Flattop Pizza + Pool and Sub Zero Microlounge, offering pizza, pool, karaoke, and art events.
